object.name: evi_damp_macro
object.digest: A 'one knob' macroisation for simple low/high onepole damping filters
object.description: A 'one knob' ('damp' parameter) macroisation for quick onepole damping filters useful for light damping or inside a feedback loop. For a similar filter with more controls @see: <o>evi.damp~</o>.

attributes.name: damp
attributes.description: The one attribute that does everything. At 0 the input signal is very slightly damped. At 1 the input signal is 100% damped. 0..1 the cutoff frequencies move from extremes to the mid range and the shelves attenuate eventually to full low/highpass filters.

attributes.name: smooth
attributes.description: Smooth the internal coefficients controlled by the 'damp' attribute, set in ms. If 0 smoothing is CPU-off.
